name: manual_a765a3
claim: Do not let an authorization require a step that the authorization itself grants: trace each prerequisite back to see whether it depends on the thing it gates, or the path can never be satisfied.

decisions.notes: 2026-10-19: an attestation that required an already-completed reservation release, while the abandon it supports is what authorizes the release, formed a circular prerequisite on the admission-won and revocation paths.

rationale: 2026-10-19: an attestation that required an already-completed reservation release, while the abandon it supports is what authorizes the release, formed a circular prerequisite on the admission-won and revocation paths.
